name: RemoveWatermarkVideo
tagline: Remove watermark and text from video online.
description: RemoveWatermarkVideo removes text watermarks, static logos and burned-in subtitles from video online, including moving and scrolling text. Upload an MP4, MOV or WebM, preview locally, then confirm the credit quote before processing. Free trial covers the first 5 seconds at up to 720p. Paid packs start at $9.90 for 500 credits; failed tasks return credits.
